rv.q: Though it is stylish, accessible and illuminated by Lily James, it misses the passionate intensity of the tragedy.
While this production fails to do justice to the play, Timothy Sheader and Dale Rooks’ Running Wild turns a second-rate script into a joyous theatrical adventure.

cn.t: Lily James shines as Juliet in this elegant but superficial production that plays it safe with old-fashioned staging. Despite flashes of wit, the show lacks romantic depth and emotional resonance.
